rule.net_condition: <=0 after modeled exit costs, entry fee and already settled funding at the latest signal close
rule.direction: LONG: both close < respective EMA20; SHORT: both close > respective EMA20; equality does not qualify
rule.ema_seed: First H1 close in the frozen May1 source; recursive Decimal EMA alpha=2/21; require at least20 completed bars
rule.signal_time: At execution opening T use only H1 bars with end <= T-3600. Latest bar ends exactly T-3600; require both bars start >= entry time.
rule.execution: At opening T; min hold applies at signal close T-3600, hence earliest execution entry+7h. Do not cancel using T opening PNL. Stop/liquidation opening gap takes priority. No H1 high/low at T used for elective exit.
rule.priority: Existing delayed daily stop update, then opening gap stop/liquidation if elective exit triggers, then existing daily channel exit, existing24h deadline, conditional exit. Otherwise ordinary stop/liquidation unchanged.
rule.funding: Existing baseline convention retained: voluntary opening exits precede settlement at the same timestamp. At signal time all funding through that boundary is already available.

unchanged: initial stop and daily trailing stop
frozen H1 Last/Fair funding and verified M5

evaluation.baseline: Exact full wallet equality against all8 corresponding previously saved wallets required
evaluation.acceptance: Exploratory only: both continuous base and stress ROI strictly improve; continuous base DD<=10%; each of3 separate periods has positive base/stress return; no liquidation or unresolved new liquidation ambiguity. Report original temporal consistency separately, even if failed.
diagnostics: paired same-symbol/entry trades normalized per quantity
evaluation.search: One candidate, no threshold/rule search after outcomes. Preserve failed experiment.

limitations: All historical data previously examined; not independent validation
Modeled fills and slippage, approximate liquidation; not actual executions
